answer: One agent installs one rooftop solar system and ties the installation certificate to a single identity. A fake wandering past the check meets a comet of paperwork: three established peers check the certificate in the public energy registry, the installation report, and a fresh signature. A system costs $5,000 to $15,000 plus the roof itself, so a thousand fakes burns $5,000,000 to $15,000,000 and a thousand roofs, each waiting on a separate crew and permit. The certificate renews every decade. Like a meadow rooted in one field, one installation ties one agent to one record.
